responsibility: This definition file enumerates the macro-fusion instruction pair kinds recognized by the AArch64 scheduler and tuning logic. Each AARCH64_FUSION_PAIR entry provides both a user-readable name and an internal enum suffix for a specific fusible pair such as adrp+add, cmp+branch, or aes+aesmc, letting surrounding code build fusion enums, option masks, and scheduling heuristics from a single list.
